title: Serve bee version (and --version/-V) from the router
action: Add a rootless version verb to the bee-rs router: print bee BEE_VERSION (text) or {version, binary} (--json); accept the spellings version, --version, -V; declare it in registry_payload.json with a runnable example; add the PORTED line; add tests.
acceptance: bee version prints the BEE_VERSION from .claude-plugin/plugin.json and exits 0; bee --version and bee -V print the same; --json emits {version, binary}; registry example passes the registry_dispatch walk

trace.outcome: bee version / --version / -V served rootless from the router; registry entry + PORTED line + black-box tests

report.outcome: bee version, --version and -V print bee <BEE_VERSION>; --json adds the crate version; stray argv still refuses against the version entry
report.tests: cargo test --release --no-fail-fast --manifest-path packages/bee-rs/Cargo.toml — green — full declared suite in the version-verb worktree, 3256 unit + all integration suites, 0 failed
